With its stunning location at Sharm El Sheikh, Rixos Premium Seagate offers a luxurious retreat overlooking the shimmering red sea.

jobs.jobInfo: Lead customer service operations across Gulf and RoMEA, focusing on process improvement, team development, and proactive distributor management.
jobs.description:
Global Customer Solutions Team Leader Gulf + RoMEA Johnson & Johnson MedTech | Distributor Markets Role Overview The Global Customer Solutions Team Leader is responsible for leading day-to-day customer service operations across Gulf and Rest of Middle East & Africa (RoMEA).

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end customer service operations across Gulf and RoMEA distributor markets, including order management, returns, delivery follow-up, invoicing support and escalations.
  • Supervise the regional team, balance workloads, set clear objectives and monitor performance against agreed service levels.

jobs.jobInfo: The role involves managing renewal contracts, enhancing customer trust, achieving financial targets, and collaborating with internal teams while being fluent in English and German.
jobs.description:
The Docusign Renewal Coordinator (RC) is a high impact position, responsible for owning and executing a portfolio of renewal contracts in an assigned territory.

Responsibility

  • Implement win/win negotiation strategies for a high quantity of renewals that enhance contract value while protecting and improving customer trust
  • Maintain and update a rolling forecast of your territory and communicate any renewal risk to internal resources
